verdict.rationale: Treg is a hosted tool-proxy service that relays and meters requests, so a data-residency or region choice is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no region selection or data-residency control for the hosted service at treg.to. The only related evidence is that 'anyone can self-host', which is an adjacent deployment option and not a documented residency feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
